mapper.insert:
insert into message
id, user_id, type, title, content, related_id, is_read, create_time, from_user_id, from_user, target_type, target_id, target_title,
#{id}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, #{createTime}, #{fromUserId}, #{fromUser}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetTitle},
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.name as fromUser, CASE WHEN m.target_type = 'blog' THEN b.title WHEN m.target_type = 'activity' THEN act.name END as targetTitle FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.from_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN blog b ON m.target_type = 'blog' AND m.target_id = b.id LEFT JOIN activity act ON m.target_type = 'activity' AND m.target_id = act.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
select count(*) from message where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = false
